question: Volcano Hellion's trigger asks how much damage to deal (to you and to its target, shown on the stack). Which amount?
rationale: Volcano Hellion's enter trigger is targeting your own Hellion (see the stack), and the chosen amount is dealt both to you and to that creature. Choose 0: any damage only costs you life and wounds your own creature; 5 or more also kills your 6/5.
